title: Micaiah Prophesies Against Ahab

questions.question: With whom did Jehoshaphat join in affinity?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:1 (ESV): "...and he joined in affinity with Ahab."

questions.question: What city did Ahab ask Jehoshaphat to help him attack?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:2-3 (ESV): "...And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, 'Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead?'"

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat ask Ahab to do first?
options: Inquire for the word of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Inquire for the word of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:4 (ESV): "...Inquire first for the word of the LORD."

questions.question: How many prophets did Ahab gather?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:5 (ESV): "Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, 400 men..."

questions.question: What did the 400 prophets say?
options: Go up, for God will give it into the hand of the king
questions.correctAnswer: Go up, for God will give it into the hand of the king
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:5 (ESV): "...And they said, 'Go up, for God will give it into the hand of the king.'"

questions.question: Who was the one prophet Ahab hated?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:7 (ESV): "...There is yet one man... but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla."

questions.question: What did Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah make for himself?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:10 (ESV): "And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron..."

questions.question: What did Micaiah first say to the king?
options: Go up and triumph; they will be given into your hand (sarcastically)
questions.correctAnswer: Go up and triumph; they will be given into your hand (sarcastically)
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:14 (ESV): "...And he said, 'Go up and triumph; they will be given into your hand.'"

questions.question: What did Micaiah see concerning all Israel?
options: Scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd
questions.correctAnswer: Scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:16 (ESV): "...I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd..."

questions.question: Who stepped forward to entice Ahab?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:20 (ESV): "Then a spirit came forward and stood before the LORD, saying, 'I will entice him.'"

questions.question: How was the spirit to entice Ahab?
options: By being a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
questions.correctAnswer: By being a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:21 (ESV): "...I will go out, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets."

questions.question: What did Zedekiah do to Micaiah?
options: He struck him on the cheek
questions.correctAnswer: He struck him on the cheek
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:23 (ESV): "Then Zedekiah... came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek..."

questions.question: What did Ahab order regarding Micaiah?
options: Put this fellow in prison and feed him with meager rations
questions.correctAnswer: Put this fellow in prison and feed him with meager rations
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:26 (ESV): "...Put this fellow in prison and feed him with meager rations of bread and water until I return in peace."

questions.question: How did Ahab try to protect himself in battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:29 (ESV): "...I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes."

questions.question: How was Ahab killed?
options: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king
questions.correctAnswer: A certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 18:33 (ESV): "But a certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel..."

key_verse_text: But Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what my God says, that I will speak.”
